SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

SELECT 
  ds.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS num_transactions,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
  AND ds.format IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

SELECT DISTINCT format
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY format

  MAX(fsl.sale_date) as max_date,
  COUNT(*) as total_lines
FROM fact_sales_line fsl

FROM dim_date dd
WHERE dd.calendar_date >= '2026-10-01'

  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.format,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS transaction_count,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) AS total_net_amount,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS lines_with_issues,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.net_amount < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_amounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_amounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsl.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_receipts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ds.format IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_format
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
